blocks.text: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 401 North Elm Street in Tuskegee, Alabama, as the "Tuskegee Airmen Memorial Post Office".
This bill would name the United States Postal Service facility at 401 North Elm Street in Tuskegee, Alabama, the "Tuskegee Airmen Memorial Post Office."
